column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Stan Welcomes the Party to Sodom
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Welcome to my city of Sodom!
I am $$スタン$$, this city's representative!!
$$ケルビム$$ informed us; we have been eagerly awaiting your arrival!
Amazing... It is true! A person with white $$羽$$ is the $$領主$$?!
We have a permanent polling station here, and I too was chosen fairly by vote!!
But more importantly, what do you think of these buildings?
No city but Sodom has the technical skill to build anything like this!
It is because we let capable people do important work without caring about the color of their $$羽$$!
Come, please have a look around our city!
